The '''Eternal Alliance Recon Unit''', commonly referred to as just the '''Alliance Recon Unit''', was a group of highly skilled [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] within the [[Eternal Alliance]] tasked with [[Scout/Legends|scouting]] out an area before the main Alliance forces engaged. The unit was under direct control of Alliance Intelligence and took orders from [[Theron Shan]]. In high-priority situations, they were directed by the [[Alliance Commander]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==History==
The unit was formed in [[3630 BBY]], after the death of the [[Eternal Empire]]'s Empress [[Vaylin]] and reorganization of Alliance into the [[Eternal Alliance]], in response to [[Uprisings against the Eternal Alliance|various uprisings]] sparking across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It was deployed to deal with crises such as reclaiming stolen plans for the [[Alliance base]] from the [[Dust Vipers]] pirates, liberating [[Port Nowhere]] from a [[Crimson Fang]] takeover, neutralizing Sith Lords [[Adacin]] and [[Zanisk]] in the former [[Separatist stronghold]] on [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]], and neutralizing Commander [[Kallin]] and foil his plan to bomb the Senate tower from [[The Works/Legends|The Works]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].

Their biggest operation was during the [[Assault on Denova|battle]] against General Amos Rike and his Rike's Raiders on [[Denova]]. They were meant to join the Alliance Commander in battle, but the unit's shuttle was shot down and crashed, nearly killing Raine and injuring the other members.<ref name="SWTOR" />

After the uprisings against the Alliance ended, the unit remained, ready to fight for their cause.

==Behind the scenes==
The Alliance Recon Unit appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' during various Uprisings.
